name: Prime factorization
description: You are given a positive integer n . Output its prime factorization. If n = a 1 b 1 a 2 b 2 ... a k b k ( b i > 0 ), where a k are prime numbers, the output of your program should look as follows: a 1 *...* a 1 * a 2 *...* a 2 *...* a k *...* a k , where the factors are ordered in non-decreasing order, and each factor a i is printed b i times.
input_specification: The only line of input contains an integer n ( 2 ≤ n ≤ 10000 ).
output_specification: Output the prime factorization of n , as described above.
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
